scenarios.title: Clean matched payroll run
scenarios.description: Baseline gold pack where HRIS↔Payroll joins are unique and complete, earning codes are fully mapped, and payroll-anchored reconciliation for base + variable pay is within tolerance. Intended to prove a valid run can complete and produce export-eligible evidence with worker-level explainability available for sampled workers.
source_conditions: HRIS worker/job fields present for in-scope population (SoT Matrix pilot_mandatory=Y fields).
Payroll earning lines present for in-scope paid population with payroll_run_id, pay period boundaries, currency_code.
pay_component_mapping_version is present and approved.
No off-cycle/retro lines in this scenario.
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: PASS (no FC triggers; pilot-mandatory fields and records meet usable thresholds)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: PASS (no override required; methodology_version matches run metadata)
evidence_required: Version manifest (snapshot_id, methodology_version, reconciliation_framework_v1 version, confidence_model_v1 version, pay_component_mapping_version, SoT Matrix v1 version).
Join integrity report (>=99% for required joins; 0 duplicates on mandatory keys).
Reconciliation report (base_pay_amount + variable_pay_amount within tolerance; aggregate control totals within tolerance).
Confidence outputs (field/record statuses; blocked_record_rate and low_confidence_record_rate below thresholds).
Explainability walkthrough pack for at least 1 sampled worker (inputs→versions→outputs trace).
scenarios.notes: This is the baseline against which exception scenarios are compared for rerun/version discipline.

scenarios.title: Missing payroll join
scenarios.description: An HRIS in-scope worker/assignment cannot be joined to any payroll worker/earning records for the defined pay period/run within the pilot perimeter.
source_conditions: HRIS record exists for in-scope worker and assignment_id/position_id.
Payroll extract lacks corresponding payroll_worker_id (or earning lines) for the worker within pay period boundaries.
Crosswalk/linkage keys are present but do not match any payroll record in-scope.
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: BLOCKER_EXCEPTION (join integrity failure blocks payroll-anchored reconciliation for affected records)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F2 join missing; record confidence hard-zero)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: BLOCKED (category eligibility fails due to missing mandatory join dependency)
evidence_required: Join integrity report identifying HRIS-only orphan records and join boundary rates.
Exception register entry for JOIN_MISSING_PAYROLL with owner role and rerun_required=true evidence links.
Run-level gate evaluation showing export blocked and downstream outputs not produced.
scenarios.notes: Maps to Validation Charter G7 join integrity gate and Confidence Model FC-F2.

scenarios.title: Duplicate join key
scenarios.description: A pilot-mandatory identifier expected to be unique (e.g., worker_id or payroll_worker_id within provider context) appears more than once, creating ambiguous join cardinality and double-counting risk.
source_conditions: At least one mandatory join key has duplicate values within the declared grain.
Join boundary produces 1:many or many:many results where 1:1 is expected.
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: BLOCKER_EXCEPTION (reconciliation cannot proceed defensibly under ambiguous join)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F2 ambiguous join; record confidence hard-zero)
evidence_required: Duplicate key/cardinality breach report with affected identifiers (restricted access).
Exception register entry for JOIN_DUPLICATE_KEY with rerun_required=true.
Gate evaluation record demonstrating no smoothing/selection of candidate records occurred.
scenarios.notes: This scenario explicitly tests the confidence model 'do not smooth ambiguity' rule.

scenarios.title: Unmapped earning code
scenarios.description: A payroll earning code present in in-scope earning lines has no approved mapping to canonical pay components, risking silent pay leakage.
source_conditions: Payroll extract includes earning_code value not present in approved mapping version.
The earning line is in-scope for remuneration truth (base/variable components).
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: BLOCKER_EXCEPTION (component mapping incomplete; totals cannot be trusted)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F3 unreconciled remuneration truth due to mapping blocker)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: PASS (methodology not the failing axis; remuneration gating blocks metrics/export)
evidence_required: Earning-code coverage report showing unmapped code(s) and affected totals.
Exception register entry for EARNING_CODE_UNMAPPED with rerun_required=true and mapping approval evidence requirement.
Reconciliation residual evidence showing out-of-tolerance or incomplete component roll-up.
scenarios.notes: Also validates SoT Matrix requirement that earning_code mapping coverage is BLOCKER for included lines.

scenarios.title: Earning code misclassification
scenarios.description: A payroll earning code is mapped but to the wrong canonical component (e.g., base vs variable), risking incorrect bonus/variable reporting even when totals appear close.
source_conditions: An earning_code is present and mapped in the mapping version.
Mapping assigns the earning_code to an incorrect canonical component for this run.
Totals may still reconcile at aggregate level but component-level residuals reveal misstatement.
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: BLOCKER_EXCEPTION (component-level reconciliation fails or reveals misstatement requiring correction)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F3; remuneration truth for component is not usable)
evidence_required: Component-level reconciliation report by earning_code showing the misclassification impact.
Evidence of payroll earning code semantic meaning used for classification (payroll controls evidence).
Mapping version change proposal/approval evidence (for future resolution) and rerun trigger note.
scenarios.notes: This is designed to prevent a false pass where aggregate control totals are within tolerance but component semantics are wrong.

scenarios.title: Retro pay present
scenarios.description: Retroactive pay adjustments are present and must be allocated consistently per pilot policy. The scenario validates that retro handling is visible, payroll-anchored, and reconciliation outcomes are deterministic.
source_conditions: Payroll extract includes retro adjustment lines or retro indicators.
Allocation to pay periods/runs is required to avoid period misstatement.
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: BLOCKER_EXCEPTION (until retro allocation policy is applied and reconciles within tolerance)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F3 while retro handling is ambiguous or out-of-tolerance)
evidence_required: Payroll retro indicator evidence and retro line inventory.
Retro allocation rule reference for the pilot perimeter (as evidence artifact).
Before/after reconciliation residual comparison demonstrating deterministic resolution via rerun.
scenarios.notes: Retro handling is a high-probability enterprise failure mode; it must not be hidden in aggregates.

scenarios.title: Off-cycle payment present
scenarios.description: An off-cycle payroll run is present. The scenario validates that off-cycle runs are explicitly flagged, included/excluded per scope, and reconciliation evidence is segmented by run type.
source_conditions: Payroll extract includes off-cycle payroll run(s) within or adjacent to the pay period perimeter.
off_cycle_flag and payroll_run_id must be present and consistent for earning lines.
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: BLOCKER_EXCEPTION (if off-cycle handling is mis-scoped or mis-allocated)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F3 if period/run alignment causes blocker reconciliation outcomes)
evidence_required: Payroll run inventory for the period including run types.
off_cycle_flag completeness/consistency report.
Reconciliation report segmented by regular vs off-cycle runs.
scenarios.notes: Validates SoT Matrix requirement that off_cycle_flag and payroll_run_id are pilot-mandatory.

scenarios.title: Missing mandatory gender
scenarios.description: A worker in the in-scope population is missing the pilot-mandatory gender field required for EU core pay gap metrics, triggering fail-closed behavior.
source_conditions: HRIS worker record is otherwise in-scope and joins to payroll.
gender is null/empty/structurally invalid for the worker.
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: PASS_WITHIN_TOLERANCE (remuneration may reconcile; failure is mandatory field completeness)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F1 FIELD_MISSING on pilot-mandatory gender; record confidence hard-zero)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: PASS (category may exist but metrics eligibility fails due to mandatory reporting dimension missing)
evidence_required: Field completeness report for pilot-mandatory fields showing gender missing count.
Confidence output showing FIELD_MISSING and ZERO status for affected record(s).
Gate evaluation demonstrating metrics/report export blocked for affected records and/or run depending on breach thresholds.
scenarios.notes: This scenario explicitly tests fail-closed posture on pilot-mandatory demographics per SoT Matrix and Confidence Model FC-F1.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous job evidence
scenarios.description: Job architecture evidence required by Methodology v1 is ambiguous or conflicting (e.g., job_level conflicts between HRIS and Reward reference), requiring review/challenge handling and blocking approval until resolved.
source_conditions: Role under review has conflicting evidence for a methodology-required identifier/attribute (e.g., job_level).
Conflict cannot be resolved within SoT precedence without a recorded disposition.
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: PASS_WITHIN_TOLERANCE (payroll reconciliation may pass; failure is methodology evidence/defensibility)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (methodology evidence conflict blocks approval; treat as EVIDENCE_MISSING_REQUIRED or effective-date mismatch where applicable)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: REVIEW_REQUIRED (challenge path triggered; no equal-value decision may be approved)
evidence_required: Methodology decision unit evidence bundle references showing conflicting evidence items and their tiers.
Recorded challenge/review stage entry (Preparation → Peer review → Legal review as required) as evidence item reference.
Confidence reasons including EVIDENCE_MISSING_REQUIRED or EFFECTIVE_DATE_MISMATCH where applicable and resulting block.
scenarios.notes: This scenario exists to prove the methodology is defensible and challengeable (not title-only).

scenarios.title: Pending override blocks downstream truth
scenarios.description: A category/equal-value override exists but is PENDING (unapproved), and therefore must not apply. Downstream metrics/reporting must fail-closed for affected records.
source_conditions: Override record exists for a worker/role/group with status PENDING.
Override would affect category truth if applied.
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F5 OVERRIDE_PENDING; record confidence hard-zero for category truth)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: BLOCKED (category truth not eligible; metrics aggregation must not use override)
evidence_required: Override record reference including requested_by, status=PENDING, and affected identifiers.
Confidence output showing OVERRIDE_PENDING reason and downstream block flags.
Evidence that SoD rule is enforced (requester != approver; approver absent while pending).
scenarios.notes: Explicitly validates Methodology v1 override governance and Confidence Model FC-F5.

scenarios.title: Approved override with evidence
scenarios.description: A narrowly scoped override is APPROVED with required evidence and expiry. The override may apply (subject to other gates), and explainability must include override rationale and evidence references.
source_conditions: Override record exists with status APPROVED, approved_by, approved_at, expiry_date present and in-date.
Override includes bounded reason_code, reason narrative, and evidence references meeting Methodology v1 minimums.
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: PASS (no OVERRIDE_* blocker; mandatory fields meet usable thresholds)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: PASS (override applies; category truth is explainable and traceable)
evidence_required: Approved override record with SoD evidence (requester != approver), and expiry_date.
Evidence bundle items supporting the override (tiered evidence references).
Explainability walkthrough showing override linkage (override_id/flag) and rationale included.
scenarios.notes: This scenario proves controlled exceptions can be governed without becoming alternate truth.

scenarios.title: Methodology version mismatch
scenarios.description: The run metadata references a methodology_version that is missing or does not match the approved/declared methodology artifact version, invalidating defensibility and requiring fail-closed blocking.
source_conditions: methodology_version in run manifest is missing or differs from expected v1.0.0 for methodology_v1.
All other data may be structurally valid.
evidence_required: Version manifest demonstrating the mismatch.
Confidence output including METHODOLOGY_VERSION_MISMATCH reason code.
Gate evaluation record showing export is blocked due to defensibility failure.
scenarios.notes: Maps directly to Confidence Model FC-F4 and Validation Charter G3/G9 defensibility/reproducibility requirements.

scenarios.title: Blocker reconciliation causes export block
scenarios.description: A blocker-level reconciliation exception occurs (e.g., aggregate totals mismatch) and must block downstream export eligibility until resolved via rerun with evidence.
source_conditions: Reconciliation detects out-of-tolerance mismatch at entity/period aggregate level.
Underlying causes may include join leakage, unmapped codes, period misalignment; scenario focuses on the control outcome.
scenarios.expected_join_outcome: PASS or WARNING (depending on underlying cause; must not hide blocker outcome)
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: FAIL_CLOSED (FC-F3 RECON_BLOCKER on mandatory remuneration truth)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: PASS (category may exist but export blocked by remuneration truth)
evidence_required: Aggregate control totals report with deltas vs payroll controls.
Drill-down residual analysis linking to underlying worker/component exceptions.
Exception register entry for AGGREGATE_CONTROL_TOTAL_MISMATCH with rerun_required=true.
scenarios.notes: Ensures fail-closed posture: no export of evidence/metrics under unresolved payroll-anchored reconciliation blockers.

scenarios.title: Breach-rate threshold invalidates metrics run
scenarios.description: Run-level rates of blocked or low-confidence records exceed confidence model thresholds, invalidating the metrics run even if some records pass individually.
source_conditions: A sufficiently large share of in-scope records are blocked (e.g., due to missing mandatory fields or join ambiguity) or are LOW confidence or below.
blocked_record_rate > 0.5% OR low_confidence_record_rate > 2.0% per confidence-model thresholds.
scenarios.expected_join_outcome: WARNING or BLOCKER (at population level; scenario evaluates run-level gating)
scenarios.expected_reconciliation_outcome: MIXED (some records may reconcile; run validity is blocked by breach rate)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: PASS for eligible records; BLOCKED for non-eligible records; run validity is blocked overall
evidence_required: Run-level confidence summary showing blocked_record_rate and low_confidence_record_rate and comparison to thresholds.
Gate evaluation record showing FC-R1 fired and metrics run labeled NOT_VALID / blocked.
Decision log reference requirement for any attempted risk acceptance (per Validation Charter Section 12).
scenarios.notes: This scenario is required to prevent 'partial pass' outputs being treated as compliant when population quality is insufficient.

scenarios.title: Worker-level explainability trace complete
scenarios.description: A sampled worker has a complete explainability trace linking source extracts → joins → derivations → governance versions → overrides/decisions → final output values, sufficient to satisfy Validation Charter Gate G9.
source_conditions: Worker is in-scope and included in computation outputs.
Explainability trace references are present and resolvable to evidence bundle items.
No unresolved blocker exceptions for the sampled worker.
scenarios.expected_confidence_outcome: PASS (field and record confidence usable; reason codes explain any non-blocking reductions)
scenarios.expected_category_or_methodology_outcome: PASS (category assignment basis and any override evidence is traceable)
evidence_required: Explainability walkthrough pack for the worker including: identifiers (restricted), join evidence references, payroll earning lines and mapped components, methodology_version and mapping versions, category basis, override record (if any), confidence reasons, and final outputs.
Evidence bundle index linking each trace step to immutable artifact references.
Reproducibility statement: same snapshot/run + same versions reproduces same trace.
scenarios.notes: This scenario tests the end-to-end explainability requirement explicitly; it must not be implied by other passes.
